info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Creditcard Applications Limits-v2-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Application Limits API provides the ability to retrieve the current limits on credit card applications. This endpoint allows users to obtain essential information regarding application thresholds and restrictions. Typically utilized by financial institutions and application processing teams, this API helps ensure compliance with lending regulations and internal policies. The API is designed to facilitate efficient assessment of application limits, thereby supporting the operational needs of credit card issuance and management.

get.summary: Retrieve the limit information for applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current limit settings for applications. Utilize this information to manage your application usage effectively and adhere to organizational policies.

requestBody.description: A request body containing the criteria to limit application results when retrieving data.

ListCreditcardApplicationsLimitsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on applications with a limit. It contains a string value.

ListCreditcardApplicationsLimitsResponse.title: Application Limit Response
